summary: This Form 8-K reports the closing of the underwriters' over-allotment option and a concurrent private placement for APEX Tech Acquisition Inc., a blank-check company. The filing details the exercise of 302,869 Units at $10.00 each for additional gross proceeds of $3,028,690, and the private placement of 3,029 Private Placement Units at $10.00 each for $30,285. No business combination, strategic event, or special situation is announced; it is a routine capital-formation update post-IPO. The sole exhibit is an unaudited pro forma balance sheet. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no risk-arb angle; the filing simply reflects ordinary IPO mechanics.
